entries.name: sim_print_int
entries.summary: Print integer. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_print_float
entries.summary: Print float. value: float to print.

entries.name: sim_print_double
entries.summary: Print double. value: double to print.

entries.name: sim_print_string
entries.summary: Print string. text: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string to print.

entries.name: sim_read_int
entries.summary: Read integer. Result: contains the integer parsed from the input line.

entries.name: sim_read_float
entries.summary: Read float. Result: contains the floating-point value parsed from the input line.

entries.name: sim_read_double
entries.summary: Read double. Result: contains the double-precision value parsed from the input line.

entries.name: sim_read_string
entries.summary: Read string. buffer: address of input buffer. size: size of input buffer in bytes.

entries.name: sim_sbrk
entries.summary: Sbrk (allocate heap memory). bytes: number of bytes to allocate. Result: contains address of allocated memory.

entries.name: sim_exit
entries.summary: Exit (terminate execution).

entries.name: sim_print_char
entries.summary: Print character. character: character to print.

entries.name: sim_read_char
entries.summary: Read character. Result: contains the input character code.

entries.name: sim_open
entries.declaration: int sim_open(const char *path, int flags, int mode)
entries.summary: Open file. path: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path. flags: flags. mode: mode. Result: contains file descriptor (-1 if error).

entries.name: sim_read
entries.declaration: int sim_read(int fd, void *buffer, int length)
entries.summary: Read from file. fd: file descriptor. buffer: address of input buffer. length: maximum number of bytes to read. Result: contains number of bytes read (0 if end-of-file, -1 if error).

entries.name: sim_write
entries.declaration: int sim_write(int fd, const void *buffer, int length)
entries.summary: Write to file. fd: file descriptor. buffer: address of output buffer. length: number of bytes to write. Result: contains number of bytes written (-1 if error).

entries.name: sim_close
entries.summary: Close file. fd: file descriptor.

entries.name: sim_exit2
entries.summary: Exit2 (terminate with value). code: termination result.

entries.name: sim_time
entries.summary: Time (program time).

entries.name: sim_midi_out
entries.declaration: void sim_midi_out(int pitch, int duration, int instrument, int volume)
entries.summary: MIDI out. pitch: pitch, 0 to 127: 60 is middle C, 62 is D, 64 is E; each step is one semitone. duration: duration in milliseconds. instrument: instrument sound from the General MIDI list, numbered from 0 to 127: 0 piano, 40 violin, 56 trumpet, 73 flute. volume: volume, 0 (silent) to 127 (loudest).

entries.name: sim_sleep
entries.summary: Sleep. milliseconds: the length of time to sleep in milliseconds.

entries.name: sim_midi_out_sync
entries.declaration: void sim_midi_out_sync(int pitch, int duration, int instrument, int volume)
entries.summary: MIDI out synchronous. pitch: pitch, 0 to 127: 60 is middle C, 62 is D, 64 is E; each step is one semitone. duration: duration in milliseconds. instrument: instrument sound from the General MIDI list, numbered from 0 to 127: 0 piano, 40 violin, 56 trumpet, 73 flute. volume: volume, 0 (silent) to 127 (loudest).

entries.name: sim_print_hex
entries.summary: Print integer in hexadecimal. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_print_binary
entries.summary: Print integer in binary. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_print_unsigned
entries.summary: Print integer as unsigned. value: integer to print.

entries.name: sim_random_seed
entries.summary: Set seed. generator: generator ID: any integer selects an independent pseudorandom sequence. seed: seed for corresponding pseudorandom number generator.

entries.name: sim_random_int
entries.summary: Random int. generator: generator ID: any integer selects an independent pseudorandom sequence. Result: contains the next pseudorandom, uniformly distributed int value from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_random_int_range
entries.summary: Random int range. generator: generator ID: any integer selects an independent pseudorandom sequence. bound: upper bound of range of returned values. Result: contains pseudorandom, uniformly distributed int value in the range 0 <= [int] < [upper bound], drawn from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_random_float
entries.summary: Random float. generator: generator ID: any integer selects an independent pseudorandom sequence. Result: contains the next pseudorandom, uniformly distributed float value in the range 0.0 <= f < 1.0 from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_random_double
entries.summary: Random double. generator: generator ID: any integer selects an independent pseudorandom sequence. Result: contains the next pseudorandom, uniformly distributed double value in the range 0.0 <= f < 1.0 from this random number generator's sequence.

entries.name: sim_confirm_dialog
entries.summary: ConfirmDialog. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is the message to user. Result: contains value of user-chosen option 0: Yes 1: No 2: Cancel.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_int
entries.summary: InputDialogInt. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is the message to user. status: contains status value 0: OK status -1: input data cannot be correctly parsed -2: Cancel was chosen -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. Result: contains int read.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_float
entries.summary: InputDialogFloat. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is the message to user. status: contains status value 0: OK status -1: input data cannot be correctly parsed -2: Cancel was chosen -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. Result: contains the floating-point value parsed from the input line.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_double
entries.summary: InputDialogDouble. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is the message to user. status: contains status value 0: OK status -1: input data cannot be correctly parsed -2: Cancel was chosen -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. Result: contains the double-precision value parsed from the input line.

entries.name: sim_input_dialog_string
entries.declaration: int sim_input_dialog_string(const char *message, char *buffer, int size)
entries.summary: InputDialogString. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is the message to user. buffer: address of input buffer. size: size of input buffer in bytes. Result: contains status value 0: OK status. Buffer contains the input string. -2: Cancel was chosen. No change to buffer. -3: OK was chosen but no data had been input into field. No change to buffer. -4: length of the input string exceeded the specified maximum. Buffer contains the maximum allowable input string plus a terminating null..

entries.name: sim_message_dialog
entries.summary: MessageDialog. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is the message to user. type: the type of message to be displayed: 0: error message, indicated by Error icon 1: information message, indicated by Information icon 2: warning message, indicated by Warning icon 3: question message, indicated by Question icon other: plain message (no icon displayed).

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_int
entries.summary: MessageDialogInt. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is an information-type message to user. value: int value to display in string form after the first string.

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_float
entries.summary: MessageDialogFloat. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is an information-type message to user. value: float value to display in string form after the first string.

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_double
entries.summary: MessageDialogDouble. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is an information-type message to user. value: double value to display in string form after the first string.

entries.name: sim_message_dialog_string
entries.summary: MessageDialogString. message: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string that is an information-type message to user. text: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 string to display after the first string.

entries.name: sim_lseek
entries.declaration: int sim_lseek(int fd, int offset, int whence)
entries.summary: Lseek (move file position). fd: file descriptor. offset: offset in bytes. whence: where the offset counts from: 0 the start of the file, 1 the current position, 2 the end of the file. Result: contains the new position, counted from the beginning of the file (-1 if error).

entries.name: sim_unlink
entries.summary: Unlink (delete a file). path: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path of the file to delete. Result: contains 0 if the file was deleted, or a negative error number.

entries.name: sim_mkdir
entries.summary: Mkdir (make a folder). path: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path of the new folder. Result: contains 0 if the folder was made, or a negative error number.

entries.name: sim_rmdir
entries.summary: Rmdir (delete an empty folder). path: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path of the folder to delete. Result: contains 0 if the folder was deleted, or a negative error number.

entries.name: sim_rename
entries.summary: Rename (rename or move a file). from: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path of the file. to: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path it moves to. Result: contains 0 if the file was renamed, or a negative error number.

entries.name: sim_stat
entries.summary: Stat (describe a path). path: address of NUL-terminated UTF-8 path. buffer: address of a buffer of 104 bytes, which the service fills. Result: contains 0 if the buffer was filled, or a negative error number.

entries.name: sim_getdents
entries.declaration: int sim_getdents(int fd, void *buffer, int length)
entries.summary: Getdents (list a folder). fd: file descriptor of a folder, opened with service 13 and flag 0. buffer: address of the buffer to fill. length: size of the buffer in bytes. Result: contains the number of bytes stored, 0 once every entry has been listed, or a negative error number.

entries.name: sim_keyboard_ready
entries.summary: Returns nonzero if a typed character is waiting.

entries.name: sim_keyboard_read
entries.summary: Reads and removes the waiting character. Check sim_keyboard_ready first.

entries.name: sim_display_ready
entries.summary: Returns nonzero if the Terminal can accept a character.

entries.name: sim_display_write
entries.summary: Prints a character in the Terminal. Character 12 clears the Terminal.

entries.name: sim_rgb
entries.declaration: unsigned sim_rgb(int red, int green, int blue)
entries.summary: Creates a Screen color from red, green and blue components, each from 0 to 255.

entries.name: SIM_SCREEN
entries.summary: Defines a global array of Screen cells and configures the Screen at Build. Use outside functions; each cell covers unit by unit pixels.

entries.name: sim_synth_play
entries.summary: Sets frequency in Hz and turns the gate on. If it is already on, turn it off first with sim_synth_gate(channel, 0) to start another attack.

entries.name: sim_synth_gate
entries.summary: Changes a Synth channel's gate: off to on starts attack, on to off starts release. Keeping the same gate value does not retrigger.

entries.name: sim_synth_upload
entries.declaration: void sim_synth_upload(const void *source, unsigned length, unsigned offset)
entries.summary: Immediately copies signed 8-bit sample bytes from source into shared Sample memory at offset. Length 0 means 65,536 bytes; the destination wraps at 65,536.

entries.name: sim_input_present
entries.summary: Returns nonzero if the Input controller is there: its ID register reads "INP". In MARS and RARS it reads 0.

entries.name: sim_input_pending
entries.summary: Returns how many events wait in the queue, from the Status register. Reading it takes nothing.

entries.name: sim_input_event
entries.summary: Takes the oldest event out of the queue and returns it, or 0 when the queue is empty. Read its fields with SIM_INPUT_KIND and SIM_INPUT_CODE.

entries.name: sim_input_key_down
entries.summary: Returns nonzero if the key with this HID usage, a SIM_KEY_ name, is held now.

entries.name: sim_input_pointer
entries.summary: Returns the pointer register: read it with SIM_INPUT_X, SIM_INPUT_Y and SIM_INPUT_BUTTONS.

entries.name: opendir
entries.summary: Opens the folder at path for readdir; returns a DIR, or NULL with errno set (ENOENT, or ENOTDIR for a file).

entries.name: readdir
entries.summary: The folder's next entry, "." and ".." first; NULL at the end, with errno unchanged, or NULL with errno set on a failure.

entries.name: closedir
entries.summary: Closes a folder opendir opened and frees it; returns 0.

entries.name: rename
entries.summary: Renames or moves the file at from to the path to, whose folder must exist, replacing a file already at to; returns 0, or -1 with errno set: EISDIR when either path is a folder, but ENOTDIR for a folder onto a file.

entries.name: remove
entries.summary: Deletes the file at path, or the folder at path when it is empty; returns 0, or -1 with errno set.

entries.name: stat
entries.summary: Describes what is at path in *buf: its kind and permissions in st_mode, a file's size in st_size; returns 0, or -1 with errno set (ENOENT when nothing is there).

entries.name: mkdir
entries.summary: Makes a folder at path, whose own folder must exist, ignoring mode; returns 0, or -1 with errno set (EEXIST when something is there already).

entries.name: unlink
entries.summary: Deletes the file at path; returns 0, or -1 with errno set (EISDIR for a folder, which rmdir deletes).

entries.name: rmdir
entries.summary: Deletes the folder at path when it is empty; returns 0, or -1 with errno set (ENOTEMPTY when it holds anything).
